sections.heading: A 31st Edition, Community-Rooted
paragraphs: The Thai Sikh Run offers two distances -- 21.098K and 10K -- near Old Siam Plaza, Bangkok. [1] The 2027 race marks its 31st edition, organised by the Thai Sikh community organising committee -- a multi-decade track record built on genuine community roots rather than commercial sponsorship.

sections.heading: Bangkok's Sikh Heritage in Phahurat
paragraphs: Sikhism arrived in Thailand in the late 19th and early 20th centuries, as Punjabi migrants came as soldiers and guards under British influence, or ventured into textile trading. [2] By 1911, religious gatherings were held in homes; the first gurdwara opened in Bangkok in 1913, with the permanent Gurdwara Siri Guru Singh Sabha -- located in the Phahurat district near this race's Old Siam Plaza venue -- completed in 1933. Today it remains the spiritual centre of Thailand's Sikh community, among roughly 20 gurdwaras nationwide.
